verdict.rationale: The README has a Getting Started section covering many harnesses, with short install paths: two `/plugin` commands for Claude Code, a one-line `devin plugins install` for Devin, and skills that auto-trigger after install. A recorded hands-on probe confirms a real keyless end-to-end install (`npx skills add obra/superpowers --skill test-driven-development`) that copied the skill and read it back cleanly. missing for 10: no explicit timed or under-five-minutes walkthrough, installation differs per harness, and the Codex/OpenCode install asks the agent to fetch and follow a raw INSTALL.md rather than a uniform one-command quickstart.
